result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the restaurant name in the 'Popular right now' list is hard-clipped mid-character instead of being properly truncated, which reads as a rendering bug. A couple of minor contrast/consistency observations are also noted. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title renders as 'Tokumaru Rame' with the final glyph sliced in half vertically (no ellipsis). The text is being clipped by the fixed-width container reserved for the rating ('4.8 (500+)') rather than truncated cleanly, making the name look broken and unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper single-line truncation (text-overflow: ellipsis / numberOfLines=1 with flex-shrink) to the title so it ends with '…', and let the rating block keep its intrinsic width. Verify with long names such as 'Tokumaru Ramen & Noodle Bar'.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is a very light gray on a near-white fill, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio needed for readable text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color (e.g., to a mid-gray around #6B7280) so it meets WCAG AA contrast against the input background.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' thumbnails are visually inconsistent: the first card uses a light gray backdrop while the others use dark blurred backdrops, and the food illustrations vary in scale/crop, making the row look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (consistent background tone, padding and subject scale) or apply a uniform overlay/gradient so all cards in the row share the same visual weight.
